name: Yemen
shortSummary: India's ties with Yemen have been constrained by the country's ongoing civil war; India conducted a major evacuation of its nationals and other foreign citizens during the 2015 crisis (Operation Raahat).

majorChallenges.title: Civil war
majorChallenges.description: Yemen's prolonged conflict severely limits the scope of bilateral engagement.
